--- title: bc.list --- ## Broadcasted Operations for Recursive Arrays {.unnumbered} ### Description The bc.list() function performs broadcasted operations on 2 Recursive arrays.
### Usage 
bc.list(x, y, f, ...)

## S4 method for signature 'ANY'
bc.list(x, y, f)
### Arguments
x, y conformable Recursive vectors/arrays (i.e. vectors/arrays of type list).
f a function that takes in exactly 2 arguments, and returns a result that can be stored in a single element of a list.
... further arguments passed to or from methods.

### Value A recursive array.

### See Also [broadcast_operators](aaa01_broadcast_operators.qmd)
### Examples ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library("broadcast") x.dim <- c(10, 2,2) x.len <- prod(x.dim) gen <- function(n) sample(list(letters, month.abb, 1:10), n, TRUE) x <- array(gen(10), x.dim) y <- array(gen(10), c(10,1,1)) bc.list( x, y, \(x, y)x %in% y ) ## , , 1 ## ## [,1] [,2] ## [1,] logical,12 logical,12 ## [2,] logical,10 logical,10 ## [3,] logical,26 logical,26 ## [4,] logical,26 logical,26 ## [5,] logical,10 logical,10 ## [6,] logical,26 logical,26 ## [7,] logical,10 logical,10 ## [8,] logical,12 logical,12 ## [9,] logical,12 logical,12 ## [10,] logical,12 logical,12 ## ## , , 2 ## ## [,1] [,2] ## [1,] logical,12 logical,12 ## [2,] logical,10 logical,10 ## [3,] logical,26 logical,26 ## [4,] logical,26 logical,26 ## [5,] logical,10 logical,10 ## [6,] logical,26 logical,26 ## [7,] logical,10 logical,10 ## [8,] logical,12 logical,12 ## [9,] logical,12 logical,12 ## [10,] logical,12 logical,12 ``` :::
